title: Grateful Dead Live at Ohio Theatre on 1971-10-31

ai_review.summary: Good‑sound recording of an early‑Dead set despite several missing tracks, capturing the fun energy of the era.
ai_review.review: The tape delivers decent sound quality that lets listeners enjoy the early‑Dead vibe and strong playing, especially the opening intro. Reviewers note a number of songs are absent from the source, which makes the set feel incomplete, but the overall mood remains high‑energy and nostalgic.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is praised for energy and early‑Dead feel but is hampered by many missing tunes; recording quality is described as good, leading to a solid mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers mention good sound quality and clear playing, with no specific complaints about hiss or dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set is incomplete; many tracks from Set One are missing, which disrupts the natural flow despite a strong opening intro.
